author: Techno Tim
description:
This was my first time at COMPUTEX, and honestly, it was overwhelming in the best way.

As a software engineer and a homelabber, I came into the show expecting a lot of AI hardware, but I did not expect almost everything to be AI. NVIDIA’s influence was everywhere, from data center platforms to local AI machines, edge devices, workstations, and mini PCs.

But I wanted this video to be more than just "AI was everywhere." I tried to look at COMPUTEX through my own lens: what stood out, what felt practical, what seemed weird, and what I would actually care about as someone who builds, self-hosts, works with infrastructure, and pays attention to real-world hardware and software.

So in this recap, I’m talking about the AI wave, RTX Spark, GB10-style systems, NVIDIA Vera Rubin hardware, ASUS, ASUSTOR, ASRock, MINISFORUM, Noctua, Seasonic, KVMs, open source projects, mini PCs, NAS gear, and some of the non-AI things I managed to find on the show floor.

title: I Went to COMPUTEX 2026. Here’s What Actually Stood Out
